entries.title: II Samuel 10:2
segments: His father showed kindness unto me; this is supposed to have occurred while David was persecuted by Saul.

entries.title: II Samuel 10:3
segments: Selfish men, who intend when they can to deceive others, are ever ready to suspect that others intend to deceive them; and those who hearken to such counsellors, will be likely to be led by them into mischief.

entries.title: II Samuel 10:4
segments: Shaved off the one half of their beards; to the inhabitants of the East, the mutilating of the beard is considered a great disgrace.

entries.title: II Samuel 10:5
segments:
Jericho; one of the first towns to which they came, after crossing the Jordan on their return. 
 
Those who in the discharge of duty are dishonorably and basely treated, should not be cast down by the indignities of the wicked, and should receive from their friends special kindness.

entries.title: II Samuel 10:6
segments:
Beth-rehob; on the northern borders of Palestine, in the valleys of Lebanon. 
 
  Zoba; a part of Syria north-east of Palestine. 
 
  Ish-tob; rather, "the men of Tob."  The land of Tob was beyond Jordan,

. 
 
  King Maacah; or, the king of Maacah,
.  Maacah is supposed to have been at the foot of Hermon, near Geshur.
Those who are most ready to give needless and wanton offence, are most backward to make amends for it, and often proceed from one offence to another till they are ruined.

entries.title: II Samuel 10:8
segments: The entering in of the gate; the gate of Medeba, a city in the tribe of Reuben, near the border of the Ammonites, and in their possession.

entries.title: II Samuel 10:9
segments:
Before and behind; the Syrians on one side and the Ammonites on the other. 
 
  The Syrians; all the people named in

, as hired by the Ammonites. 
 
The fact that men are dependent on God, and that he gives success to whomsoever he will, does not supersede the necessity of their using the most appropriate means; for by such means God usually works, in accomplishing the end.

entries.title: II Samuel 10:12
segments: A conviction and acknowledgement of dependence on God for success in the use of means, is one of the surest ways of obtaining it.

entries.title: II Samuel 10:16
segments:
Hadarezer; the king of Zoba. 
 
  The river; Euphrates. 
 
All the efforts of men to thwart the counsels of God, and to succeed in opposition to him, will be in vain, and in the end will recoil on themselves.
